claims.text: SPA's English release of a Royal Court statement, datelined Riyadh, Rabi II 3, 1436 / 23 January 2015, says Crown Prince Salman bin Abdulaziz, the family and the nation mourn King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz, who died at one o'clock that morning, Friday 03/04/1436 AH. Funeral prayers are set for after Asr that day at Imam Turki bin Abdullah Mosque in Riyadh.
claims.locator: Dateline; first Royal Court statement; trailer (10:44 local time)
claims.uncertainty: He is styled King at his death, so this statement is the evidence for the end of his reign.

claims.text: A second Royal Court statement in the same release says Crown Prince Salman bin Abdulaziz received the pledge of allegiance as King in accordance with the Basic Law of Governance.
claims.uncertainty: Accession by pledge; no coronation, oath or inauguration is described. The statement gives no time for the pledge. It followed the death at 1 a.m. on 23 January, and the Arabic original was filed at 02:33 Makkah time that day, so the pledge falls on 23 January 2015.

claims.text: After that pledge was completed, King Salman called for the pledge to Prince Muqrin bin Abdulaziz as Crown Prince under item Second of Royal Order A/86 dated 26/5/1435 AH, which provided for the pledge to Muqrin in the event of a vacancy in the crown princeship, and Muqrin received it.
claims.uncertainty: This English release renders A/86 as 'Royal Decree'; the Arabic original (sa_spa_abdullah_death_20150123_ar) and Royal Order A/160 call it a Royal Order (al-amr al-malaki). A/86 itself was not read and its Gregorian date was not verified. No separate time is given for Muqrin's pledge.

claims.text: The statement says the citizens' pledge to King Salman and Crown Prince Muqrin will begin at the Governance Palace (Qasr al-Hukm) in Riyadh after Isha prayers that day, Friday 03/04/1436 AH.
claims.locator: Second Royal Court statement, final sentence
claims.uncertainty: A scheduled event; this source does not attest that the citizens' pledge took place.

scope_note: English release of the two Royal Court statements; the Arabic original is sa_spa_abdullah_death_20150123_ar. The English dateline (23 January 2015) agrees with the day of death in the body. Used for SA-EXEC-05.
